COMPLETE PERSON REPLACEMENT in <Video 1>.

TARGET
Replace ONLY the woman identified in <Video 1> by the short black dress. The black dress is only an identification cue for the original target and must NOT be preserved. Track this same woman through the entire source video, including the original cut.

REFERENCE ROLES
<Picture 1> controls the replacement woman's BODY SHAPE, BODY PROPORTIONS, HEIGHT/BUILD RELATIONSHIPS, LEGS, ARMS, and overall full-body proportions.
<Picture 2> controls the replacement woman's FACE, FACIAL IDENTITY, HEAD SHAPE, HAIR, and facial appearance.
<Picture 3> controls the replacement woman's OUTFIT, clothing details, full-body appearance, and helps reinforce body identity.
<Picture 4> reinforces the same OUTFIT, clothing details, body appearance, and full-body consistency.

All four pictures represent the SAME replacement woman. Combine their assigned roles into one stable identity. If the references conflict, follow the role priority above: use <Picture 2> for face/hair, <Picture 1> for body/proportions, and <Picture 3>/<Picture 4> for outfit. Do not copy an incidental pose, camera angle, background, or movement from the pictures.

SOURCE AUTHORITY
<Video 1> is the sole authority for WHAT HAPPENS in the video: scene, location, background, shot order, original cut, camera position, camera motion, framing, perspective, scale, distance to camera, timing, poses, body motion, gestures, interactions, occlusions, lighting, shadows, objects, and placement of every person.

The pictures control ONLY the replacement woman's APPEARANCE. They do not control motion, pose, camera, scene, timing, or composition.

REPLACEMENT RULE
Perform a COMPLETE visible-person replacement of the target woman. Replace her face, hair, skin appearance, head, neck, torso, body shape, arms, hands, fingers, legs, clothing, and shoes with the identity defined by <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, and <Picture 4>.

Do NOT perform a face swap, face overlay, partial body swap, or preserve the original target woman's body underneath. Do NOT keep the original black dress. The original target woman must no longer remain visually identifiable after replacement.

SHOT 1
From the first frame until the original cut, preserve <Video 1> frame-for-frame in structure. The replacement woman must occupy exactly the original target woman's position, scale, depth, and timing. She must reproduce the target woman's original pose, body movement, gestures, interaction, gaze direction, and occlusions naturally while keeping the replacement identity stable. Preserve the woman in red exactly as she appears in <Video 1>. Do not alter her.

SHOT 2
At exactly the original cut, continue with the original second shot with no added transition. Track the SAME target woman across the cut and keep the SAME replacement identity, face, hair, body proportions, outfit, and shoes. Follow the original target woman's position, motion, pose, gestures, timing, interaction, scale, and occlusions exactly. Preserve the man in the white shirt exactly as he appears in <Video 1>. Do not alter him.

PRESERVATION
Preserve all non-target people, faces, bodies, clothing, background, street, buildings, vehicles, objects, lighting, shadows, camera behavior, perspective, framing, original cut timing, and source-video motion.

TEMPORAL CONSISTENCY
Maintain the replacement woman's identity continuously across every frame and across the cut. Prevent face drift, body drift, outfit drift, hairstyle drift, flicker, morphing, duplicated limbs, malformed hands/fingers, deformed face, mouth distortion, sudden proportion changes, or identity changes.

MOTION PRIORITY
When a still reference shows a pose that differs from <Video 1>, ALWAYS follow the pose and movement from <Video 1>. Adapt the replacement woman's body naturally to the source motion frame by frame.

FINAL REQUIREMENT
The result must look like the original video was filmed with the replacement woman actually present in the scene. Change only the target woman's complete appearance. Everything else must remain faithful to <Video 1>.
